summary: Vizsla Silver Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on NYSE, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General and Special Meeting and Management Information Circular dated August 27, 2026, for a shareholder meeting on October 8, 2026 in Vancouver, alongside a Notice and Access document and proxy form. The circular reviews fiscal 2026 milestones: the November 2025 Panuco Feasibility Study (after-tax NPV 5% of US$1.8 billion, 111% IRR, 7-month payback, 12.8 Mt at 416 g/t AgEq reserves), a US$300 million convertible senior notes offering, a US$10 million FIFOMI working capital facility, US$427.3 million cash, and recent executive appointments. No transaction, tender, activist, or structural event is disclosed; this is routine meeting and proxy material, so the special-situations read-through is none. Watch only for any dissident nominations or say-on-pay dissent at the October 8 meeting.
